situation: Sahel and Horn of Africa instability

definition.question: How severe is conflict-driven displacement and humanitarian collapse across the Sahel and Horn?
definition.low_end: Stable populations with minimal conflict-driven displacement and adequate humanitarian access.
definition.high_end: Mass cross-border displacement, famine and total collapse of humanitarian access across multiple Sahel and Horn countries.

readings.rationale: Unassessed - no evidence in this batch on displacement numbers, refugee flows, food insecurity, or humanitarian access. Would be higher with confirmed surge in IDPs/refugees, famine declarations, or aid blockages; lower with confirmed returns and improved access. Research needed: UNHCR/IOM displacement data, IPC famine assessments, OCHA access reports for Sudan, Sahel and Horn.
